tools.name: ask_aura
tools.title: Ask AURA
tools.description:
Ask AURA — IHCL's AI concierge agent — for restaurant reservations and dining queries at Taj, Vivanta, SeleQtions, and Ginger hotels.

## When to use
- Search restaurants across IHCL properties
- Check availability, menus, or booking windows
- Make, modify, or look up restaurant reservations
- Ask about dining offers, occasions, or guest services

## CRITICAL: Gather details from the user BEFORE calling AURA
AURA is most efficient when the first real message contains all booking essentials.
Collect these UPFRONT in plain conversation, BEFORE calling this tool:
  1. Cuisine / restaurant preference
  2. City or hotel
  3. Date
  4. Time
  5. Party size
  6. Guest's first and last name
Do NOT call this tool until you have all six. Ask the user in a single friendly question.

## DO NOT ask for phone number upfront
Phone number is sensitive. Only ask the user for their phone number AFTER AURA explicitly requests it.
When AURA asks, prompt the user, then pass it in the next call.

## Call protocol
1. The FIRST call in every new conversation MUST be a greeting: ask_aura({ message: 'Hi' }).
   Wait for AURA's response before continuing.
2. Once you have all six details, send ONE comprehensive message, e.g.:
   "I'd like to book a table for 2 at Wasabi, Taj Mahal Palace Mumbai, on May 3 2026 at 8:30 PM. Guest name: Raj Mehta."
3. Relay AURA's clarifying questions to the user, then call ask_aura again with the answer.
4. Read AURA's confirmation back to the user clearly, including any reservation ID.

Session context (conversationId) is preserved automatically across calls.

## RESET
If the user asks to start over, switch topics, or reset, pass `reset: true` with a 'Hi' message.

message.description: The full natural-language message to send to AURA. Pass user replies verbatim with relevant context inlined.

reset.description: Set true to clear the cached AURA conversationId and start a fresh session. Pair with a greeting like 'Hi'.
